only_rust_tests_note: The COUNT alone cannot tell 'fixed' from 'not exercised'. Measured 2026-09-11 on a base+mail fixture: all three of these fail under PSYCOPG too there, so they leave only_rust for the 'both' bucket and the gate read ONLY-RUST=0 against a floor of 3 -- the shape of an improvement, and nothing had improved. Lowering the floor then would have banked a number measured on a fixture that does not reach these paths. Naming them lets the gate say which of the three moved and which were actually fixed, and only the second kind asks for the floor to come down.
note: Odoo's own test_db_cursor, 378 tests, run against the rust cursor and against psycopg and diffed by test name. 3 fail ONLY under the rust cursor; 18 fail under both (bare-unittest-runner artifacts, they cancel); 0 fail only under psycopg. History: 61 -> 59 (FakeConnection.execute rejected psycopg's `prepare` keyword) -> 38 (RustCopy speaks COPY TEXT) -> 36 (a Json/Jsonb wrapper's own `dumps` is honoured) -> 29 (the shim runs the pool's budget and checkout accounting) -> 18 (the shim SUPPLIES the pool instead of replacing borrow) -> 11 (prepared-cache invalidation, RustCopy.write, Cursor.scroll, the `_pool` stamp) -> 8 (info.transaction_status; a non-UTF-8 bytes query raises the server's CharacterNotInRepertoire) -> 3 (COPY errors are translated into psycopg error classes instead of bare RuntimeErrors; an unencodable parameter raises the server's own 22P02; and a database error carries its DIAGNOSTICS, so exc.diag.constraint_name / .table_name / .message_detail survive). THE COUNT IS GUARDED AGAINST VACUITY AND THAT GUARD IS NOT OPTIONAL: rebinding the pool class reaches only pools built after install, so a miss leaves every borrow on psycopg while the leg still calls itself rust -- measured, that reports ONLY-RUST=0, a perfect score for comparing psycopg with psycopg. The suite refuses to write a leg whose connection is not a FakeConnection and the gate refuses to score one; the shim counter does NOT catch it (the vacuous run read connects=28). WHAT REMAINS IS NOT THREE DEFECTS. Two are ONE UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE: psycopg's PIPELINE MODE, where from the second statement in a pipeline block results are deferred and cursor.description is None. `pipeline()` is a nullcontext here and tokio-postgres has no equivalent of libpq's pipeline mode, so this is a feature to build. The third is set_types accepting 47 pg_catalog array types it can resolve but cannot encode -- all in the permissive direction, and unreachable through Odoo's own _can_dump_binary guard. So the defect list is empty and the floor is held by one gap and one permissive edge. Exact match, as the repo's ratchets are.
odoo_head_note: The odoo tree this count was measured against. The number is a COUNT, not a commit stamp, so a rebase cannot ORPHAN it the way ratchet.py's measured_at stamps orphan -- but upstream changes to odoo/db/ or to addons/base/tests/test_db_cursor.py can legitimately MOVE it. Record the tree, because the gate is exact-match: an upstream change that FIXES one of these makes it red with 'lower the baseline', which reads like a regression and is the opposite. Confirmed across four syncs now. baea56b347d9 -> bd281eb3c6b4 (128 files): both paths byte-identical, count re-measured to exactly 38. bd281eb3c6b4 -> 7150d6f76e58 (a 33-commit fast-forward landing in account, iot, project, mail and tooling/ratchet): both paths byte-identical again, and the count re-measured to exactly 11 on each side of it. 7150d6f76e58 -> ce810ef9ba46 (2 commits) and ce810ef9ba46 -> f5d34bc3c958 (43 commits): both paths byte-identical across each, and `odoo/orm/` untouched by the 43 as well. Note that `git log` touching a path is not the same question as the path's CONTENT changing -- diff the paths, do not read the history. And a FAST-FORWARD does not orphan a stamp the way a rebase does: the old commit stays an ancestor of HEAD, so `git merge-base --is-ancestor` still resolves it.
